narrative.gap_prioritization_md: Six-factor prioritization applied to all 17 categories. Gaps are ranked by composite priority score. Top 3-5 gaps receive root cause analysis below the register.
narrative.recommendations_md:
Each recommendation follows the mandatory anti-generic protocol: ROOT CAUSE (E-IDs confirming the gap is real) → SOLUTION (specific Zennify offering) → EXPECTED OUTCOMES (metrics). The specificity test was applied to every recommendation: if the text could apply unchanged to a different institution, it was rewritten with ANBTX-specific data. Technology validation (connector searches) confirmed all 8 recommendations address greenfield gaps — MuleSoft is the only exception, reframed as EXPAND not introduce.
 Expand Salesforce from nCino Commercial to FSC Retail Banking [ZENNIFY]
 Implement Marketing Cloud Engagement + Account Engagement [ZENNIFY]
 Activate Salesforce Data Cloud over Snowflake for Customer 360 [ZENNIFY]
 Evaluate and Deploy Salesforce Agentforce + Einstein AI [ZENNIFY]
 Implement Service Cloud + Digital Engagement for Omnichannel [ZENNIFY]
 Expand MuleSoft API-Led Connectivity as Core-Agnostic Integration Backbone [ZENNIFY]
 Implement Salesforce Experience Cloud for Digital Self-Service + CRA Service Test [ZENNIFY]
 Deploy Salesforce Shield for OCC/FFIEC Cybersecurity Compliance [ZENNIFY]
narrative.roadmap_md: 18-month sequenced roadmap prioritizing the three highest-ROI phases. Phase 1 establishes the Salesforce platform foundation and integration backbone. Phase 2 activates the data and marketing capabilities. Phase 3 deploys intelligence and digital access. The roadmap is designed so that each phase creates the prerequisites for the next.
